positions.name: AsyncJobContractGuarantees
positions.frame: what did ratifying the async job contract settle about remember's return behavior and how its result is later retrieved?
positions.why: All three expressions describe facets of one ratified decision: src-1 names the ratified shape itself (receipt returned in seconds, extraction watched via polling a cursor); src-2 states the guarantee that shape buys (no blocking, no lost work); src-3 spells out the retrieval mechanism the ratified contract enables (poll or piggyback). Read together they answer one question — what the contract commits to — though src-1 speaks from the settled past of ratification while src-3 lays out the still-open either/or of how retrieval actually plays out; that gap between settled commitment and open mechanism is held inside the group, not resolved.
